summary.headline: Advantia Health locks in $685K of recurring savings with another $146K underway
summary.narrative: Through Treya Partners’ strategic sourcing program, Advantia Health finalized six sourcing work-streams that will deliver $684,936 in hard annual savings and has three additional categories in active implementation worth an estimated $146,492. Key wins include a 9% fee reduction with Athena for billing/RCM, a 14% cut in medical supply costs via distributor consolidation, and a 19% savings shift to an in-house sonography staffing model. Further opportunities in IT Managed Services, lab reagents, and telecom are progressing through proposal and contracting stages.

category_results.status_notes: Athena fee reduced to 3.15% effective 9/1/22; contract addendum retroactive.
Competitive bid drove pricing; McKesson selected for Heartland region.
Conversion to in-house staffing model completed; Staffmark support optional.
Policy change to 5-unit order threshold implemented across practices.
Enrolled in Bayer’s 'Confidence in Coverage' replacement program.
Incumbent LabCorp BAFO secured; 9% price reduction effective 10/15/22.
RFP responses received; pricing analysis underway, decision target 11/15/22.
Negotiations held; supplier asked to revisit proposal after volume review Summer ’23.
Invoice review complete; RFQ package pending release to vendors.
